sentences.zh: 本周共和党全国代表大会上最令人难忘的演讲之一，来自总统的长子。

sentences.en: A blistering attack on Joe Biden and the American left.
sentences.zh: 对乔·拜登和美国左翼的猛烈抨击。

sentences.en: They want to bully us into submission.
sentences.zh: 他们想霸凌我们让我们屈服。

sentences.en: If they get their way, it will no longer be the silent majority.
sentences.zh: 如果让他们得逞，将不再是沉默的大多数。

sentences.zh: 而是被剥夺声音的大多数。

sentences.en: That predicted a national dissent into anarchy, violence, and oppression.
sentences.zh: 这预示着国家将陷入无政府状态、暴力和压迫。

sentences.zh: 有信仰的人正在受到攻击。

sentences.en: You're not allowed to go to church.
sentences.zh: 你们不被允许去教堂。

sentences.en: But mass chaos in the streets gets a pass.
sentences.zh: 但街头的空前混乱却被放行。

sentences.en: If voters do not re-elect his father.
sentences.zh: 如果选民不重新选他的父亲。

sentences.en: Imagine the life you want to have.
sentences.zh: 想象一下你想要的生活。

sentences.en: One with a great job, a beautiful home, a perfect family.
sentences.zh: 一份好工作，一个美丽的家，一个完美的家庭。

sentences.en: You can have it.
sentences.zh: 你可以拥有它。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Jason Zengerle on Don Jr.'s long journey from family outcast to right-wing star and now to his father's political heir.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事杰森·岑格勒将讲述小唐从家族边缘人到右翼明星、再到如今他父亲的政治继承人的漫长历程。

sentences.en: That is the life.
sentences.zh: 那就是生活。

sentences.en: That is the country.
sentences.zh: 那就是国家。

sentences.en: That is the world that Donald Trump and the Republican Party are after.
sentences.zh: 那就是唐纳德·特朗普和共和党追求的世界。

sentences.en: And yes, you can have it.
sentences.zh: 是的，你可以拥有它。

sentences.en: It's Friday, August 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月28日，星期五。

sentences.en: Jason, it feels like Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 杰森，感觉唐纳德·特朗普小儿子

sentences.en: has had many different lives.
sentences.zh: 经历过很多不同的人生。

sentences.en: And the most recent of those is what we saw at the Republican convention this week.
sentences.zh: 其中最近的，就是我们在本周共和党大会上看到的。

sentences.en: But where does that story start?
sentences.zh: 但这个故事是从哪里开始的？

sentences.en: It literally starts in the hospital room when he's born on New Year's Eve in 1977.
sentences.zh: 它字面意思上就始于1977年除夕他出生时的产房里。

sentences.en: His mother wrote a book a few years ago in which she recounted the scene where she tells her husband that she wants to name him Donald Jr.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲几年前写过一本书，里面回忆了她告诉丈夫她想给他起名叫小唐纳德的那一幕。

sentences.en: And Donald objects, saying, you know, no, you can't call him
sentences.zh: 而唐纳德反对说，你知道的，不行，你不能叫他

sentences.en: Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 小唐。

sentences.en: What if he's a loser?
sentences.zh: 万一他是个失败者呢？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: From there, everything else flows.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，一切都顺理成章了。

sentences.en: I used to kiss him before going to school every morning, right?
sentences.zh: 我每天早上上学前都会吻他，对吧？

sentences.en: Seven o'clock in the morning,
sentences.zh: 早上七点，

sentences.en: I'm going to school, hugs, kisses.
sentences.zh: 我要去上学，拥抱，亲吻。

sentences.en: And he used to say a couple of things.
sentences.zh: 他过去常常说几件事。

sentences.en: No smoking, no drinking, no drugs.
sentences.zh: 不吸烟，不喝酒，不吸毒。

sentences.en: But then he followed up with, don't trust anyone ever.
sentences.zh: 但他接着说，永远不要相信任何人。

sentences.en: And, you know, he followed up two seconds later with, so do you trust me?
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他两秒钟后又接着说，那你相信我吗？

sentences.en: I'd say, of course, you're my dad.
sentences.zh: 我会说，当然，你是我爸爸。

sentences.en: He said, what did I just, you know, he thought I was a total failure.
sentences.zh: 他说，我刚刚，你知道的，他觉得我完全是个失败者。

sentences.en: You guys, my son's a loser, I guess.
sentences.zh: 你们知道的，我儿子是个失败者，我想。

sentences.en: His sister, Ivanka, who was the second oldest, was clearly his father's favorite.
sentences.zh: 他的妹妹伊万卡是第二大的，显然是他父亲的最爱。

sentences.en: Which is your favorite Trump child?
sentences.zh: 谁是你最喜欢的特朗普孩子？

sentences.en: And why is it Ivanka?
sentences.zh: 为什么是伊万卡？

sentences.en: You're a wise guy over here.
sentences.zh: 你这小子。

sentences.en: And that's something that Don, you know, speaks about.
sentences.zh: 这是唐，你知道的，经常说起的事。

sentences.en: He kind of jokes about it now, but he does talk about it.
sentences.zh: 他现在有点开玩笑地谈论它，但他确实会说。

sentences.en: All the same, 100%.
sentences.zh: 完全一样，100%。

sentences.en: A hundred percent?
sentences.zh: 百分之百？

sentences.en: A hundred percent.
sentences.zh: 百分之百。

sentences.en: And I'll even say you only for purposes of this interview.
sentences.zh: 而且我甚至会说，仅为了这次采访的目的，只有你。

sentences.en: She fulfilled all the things that her father kind of envisioned for his children.
sentences.zh: 她实现了她父亲为他的孩子们所设想的一切。

sentences.en: She was a model, she was polished, she loved him immensely.
sentences.zh: 她是个模特，举止优雅，无比爱他。

sentences.en: Don had a much more tortured relationship with his dad.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，唐和父亲的关系要痛苦得多。

sentences.en: You yourself said that you saw your children maybe once a week.
sentences.zh: 你自己说过，你大概一周见一次你的孩子。

sentences.en: You know, somewhat famously after his father and his mother divorced.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，在他的父亲和母亲离婚之后。

sentences.en: You're having a lot of difficulties with your 12-year-old son, Don, and you haven't talked to him since May.
sentences.zh: 你跟你12岁的儿子唐遇到了很多困难，你们从五月份起就没说过话。

sentences.en: Don was 12 and 13 at the time, and he refused to speak to his dad for a year.
sentences.zh: 当时唐12、13岁，他整整一年拒绝和父亲说话。

sentences.en: I mean, this is a very painful situation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个非常痛苦的处境。

sentences.en: I am not going to disparage Ivanka as a woman or as a mother.
sentences.zh: 我不会贬低伊万卡作为女人或母亲的身份。

sentences.en: But he was clearly someone who was kind of being pinballed back and forth between his parents.
sentences.zh: 但他显然是个在父母之间被像弹球一样弹来弹去的人。

sentences.en: He was at a terrible age for this.
sentences.zh: 对经历这个来说，他的年龄太糟糕了。

sentences.en: He was old enough to actually realize what was going on.
sentences.zh: 他已经大到足以真正意识到发生了什么。

sentences.en: And his two siblings, Ivanka and Eric, were in some ways too young to understand.
sentences.zh: 而他的两个兄弟姐妹伊万卡和埃里克，在某种程度上还太小而无法理解。

sentences.en: He was he was old enough to understand.
sentences.zh: 他已经，他已经大到能够理解了。

sentences.en: He was old enough to get teased by his classmates.
sentences.zh: 他大到会被同班同学取笑。

sentences.en: And I think it was just a searing experience for him.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对他是段极其痛苦的经历。

sentences.en: I always feel that it's very important to be really with the children.
sentences.zh: 我一直觉得真正陪伴孩子非常重要。

sentences.en: Your son, Donald Jr.?
sentences.zh: 你的儿子，小唐纳德？

sentences.en: Donald Jr.
sentences.zh: 小唐纳德。

sentences.en: Any one of my children.
sentences.zh: 我的任何一个孩子。

sentences.en: If any one of my children call, I'll always take their call, no matter what I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 如果我的任何一个孩子打电话，我总是会接听他们的电话，无论我当时在做什么。

sentences.en: And so what is the reaction of this young man who's being pinballed between his two parents and
sentences.zh: 那么这个在父母之间被弹来弹去、

sentences.en: no doubt understanding very well that they are going through a highly public, very ugly divorce?
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问非常清楚他们正在经历一场高度公开、极其难看的离婚的年轻人，会有什么反应呢？

sentences.en: I think his reaction in some ways was just try to get away from it.
sentences.zh: 我认为他的反应在某种程度上就是试图逃离它。

sentences.en: His parents sent him to boarding school in Pennsylvania, and he just tried to forge kind of his own distinct identity there.
sentences.zh: 他的父母把他送到宾夕法尼亚州的寄宿学校，他只是试图在那里建立自己独特的身份。

sentences.en: He got really into the outdoors.
sentences.zh: 他变得非常迷恋户外活动。

sentences.en: People, these are the things we do on the weekends in our free time.
sentences.zh: 大家，这些就是我们在周末空闲时间做的事情。

sentences.en: We're shooters, we're hunters, we're outdoorsmen.
sentences.zh: 我们是射手，我们是猎人，我们是户外运动爱好者。

sentences.en: In a way that his father just couldn't understand.
sentences.zh: 以一种他的父亲根本无法理解的方式。

sentences.en: Well, they love hunting, and they've always loved hunting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们喜欢打猎，他们一直都喜欢打猎。

sentences.en: I don't.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢。

sentences.en: And just found the whole thing baffling.
sentences.zh: 并且觉得整件事令人费解。

sentences.en: But I've never been a fan, and I haven't actually seen anything, but I've never been a fan of it, no.
sentences.zh: 但我从来都不是粉丝，实际上我也没见过什么，但我从不是它的粉丝，不。

sentences.en: But Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 但小唐

sentences.en: really sort of poured himself into that.
sentences.zh: 真的把精力倾注在了那上面。

sentences.en: Then when he was going to go to college, he was thinking about actually going to University of Vermont or University of Colorado and just kind of being a ski bum.
sentences.zh: 然后当他要上大学时，他实际上在考虑去佛蒙特大学或科罗拉多大学，只是想当个滑雪流浪汉。

sentences.en: And eventually, he sort of relented to his parents' wishes, and he went to the University of Pennsylvania, where his dad had gone.
sentences.zh: 最后，他算是顺从了父母的愿望，去了他父亲去过的宾夕法尼亚大学。

sentences.en: But even there, he really kept a low profile.
sentences.zh: 但即使在那里，他也一直保持低调。

sentences.en: He did not try to make a big deal out of his name.
sentences.zh: 他没有试图拿自己的姓氏大做文章。

sentences.en: And, you know, at this point, his father was famous.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，此时他的父亲已经很有名了。

sentences.en: I mean, he wasn't obviously a politician, but he was a celebrity businessman.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他显然不是个政治家，但他是个名流商人。

sentences.en: People knew who the Trumps were.
sentences.zh: 人们知道特朗普是谁。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Is it sometimes a burden or always a luxury to have Trump as your last name?
sentences.zh: 把特朗普作为你的姓氏，有时是一种负担，还是永远是一种奢侈？

sentences.en: No, I think there's definitely a burden associated with it at times.
sentences.zh: 不，我认为有时与之相伴的绝对是一种负担。

sentences.en: You know, the people who knew him in college said he really tried to play down his name.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，大学里认识他的人说他真的很想淡化自己的姓氏。

sentences.en: Okay, so is it true that there are times when you just have introduced yourself as Don and forget the Trump part?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么这是真的吗：有时候你只会自我介绍说叫唐，而忘了特朗普这部分？

sentences.en: I do it often.
sentences.zh: 我经常这么做。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: To the point where in his fraternity, his nickname was Ron Rump, and he went by Ron.
sentences.zh: 以至于在兄弟会里，他的绰号是罗恩·朗普，他也一直自称罗恩。

sentences.en: And, you know, one of his fraternity brothers told me that he thought, you know, one of the reasons he liked the name was it just gave him another level of anonymity.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他的一位兄弟会成员告诉我，他觉得，你知道，他喜欢这个名字的原因之一是它给了他另一层匿名性。

sentences.en: So at this point, he's distancing himself from the family.
sentences.zh: 所以此时，他正在疏远这个家庭。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's trying to figure out his own path.
sentences.zh: 是的，他正在试图寻找自己的道路。

sentences.en: And after graduation, he had a job waiting for him at his father's company, but he didn't take it.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，他在父亲的公司有一份等着他的工作，但他没有接受。

sentences.en: He went out to Aspen for about a year and a half and he skied and he hunted and he fished and he was a bartender.
sentences.zh: 他在阿斯彭待了一年半左右，滑雪、打猎、钓鱼，还当过酒保。

sentences.en: I now have this image in my head of Don Jr.
sentences.zh: 我现在脑海里浮现出小唐的形象，

sentences.en: as a kind of Connor Roy figure for Succession fans or the kind of Joe Bluth of his world, right?
sentences.zh: 对于《继承之战》的粉丝来说，他有点像康纳·罗伊式的人物，或者说是他那个世界里的乔·布鲁斯，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, he's kind of dropping out of the family business and it sounds like this is rebellion.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他有点像退出了家族企业，听起来这就是叛逆。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, but after a year and a half out there, I think he thought he had to take his place
sentences.zh: 你知道，但在那里待了一年半之后，我想他觉得他必须在家族企业中占有一席之地

sentences.en: in the family business and he went back to New York City and he went to work for his dad and he gave up
sentences.zh: 他回到了纽约市，为他父亲工作，并放弃了

sentences.en: sort of the plaid flannel and the camo and he started wearing the pinstripe suits and the wide ties and slicking back his hair.
sentences.zh: 格子法兰绒和迷彩服，开始穿上细条纹西装、宽领带，并将头发梳得油光发亮。

sentences.en: And, you know, he seemed to sort of surrender to the expectations that he was he was going to become his father's protege.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他似乎向一种期望妥协了，那就是他将要成为他父亲的门徒。

sentences.en: And so how does that go for him?
sentences.zh: 那么这对他的发展如何呢？

sentences.en: The funny thing is it doesn't go all that well.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，事情并没有那么顺利。

sentences.en: What do you think are our greatest strengths and weaknesses?
sentences.zh: 你认为我们最大的优势和弱点是什么？

sentences.en: What do you think we need to improve on, work on or, you know, what things we should just leave exactly the way there are, if any?
sentences.zh: 你认为我们需要改进、努力的地方是什么，或者，你知道的，如果有的话，我们应该保持现状的有哪些？

sentences.en: It was an awkward fit for him.
sentences.zh: 这对他来说是一个不太合适的角色。

sentences.en: You're young and you're not always focused and you have to keep focused.
sentences.zh: 你还年轻，并不总是专注于一件事，你必须保持专注。

sentences.en: When times got bad, I went and focused and that's why I came out so strong and other people, they went bankrupt and gone and never, never to be seen again.
sentences.zh: 当困难时期来临时，我集中精力，这就是为什么我能表现得如此强劲，而其他人，他们破产了，消亡了，再也没有被看到过。

sentences.en: It seemed like his greatest value to the family business, oddly enough, came on the television show,
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，他对家族企业最大的价值，似乎体现在电视节目

sentences.en: The Apprentice, which he, you know, he joined as a cast member a few seasons in.
sentences.zh: 《学徒》上，你知道的，他在播出几季后作为常驻嘉宾加入了。

sentences.en: So Don and Ivanka, you have a famous father.
sentences.zh: 所以唐和伊万卡，你们有一个著名的父亲。

sentences.en: Is that easy or is it tough?
sentences.zh: 这很容易还是很难？

sentences.en: It's definitely not always easy.
sentences.zh: 绝对不是总那么容易。

sentences.en: There's definitely advantages to it.
sentences.zh: 这绝对有它的优势。

sentences.en: We've got to be spoiled, hopefully, in all the right ways.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了宠爱，希望是以所有正确的方式。

sentences.en: I think it's tough because you're tough, but in a good way.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很难，因为你很坚强，但以一种好的方式。

sentences.en: He was one of the boardroom judges.
sentences.zh: 他是董事会评委之一。

sentences.en: Why work for me?
sentences.zh: 为什么要为我工作？

sentences.en: Why not go someplace else?
sentences.zh: 为什么不去别的地方？

sentences.en: Getting to work on the best projects in the world.
sentences.zh: 能够参与世界上最好的项目。

sentences.en: And the producers and some of the people who worked on the show who were cast members talked about him as being this kind of stabilizing presence on the set,
sentences.zh: 制片人以及一些参与该节目并作为嘉宾的演员谈到他时，都说他是片场的一种稳定力量，

sentences.en: mainly because he was willing to run interference between them and his dad.
sentences.zh: 主要是因为他愿意在他们和他父亲之间充当润滑剂和缓冲。
